input.quote: Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form. Vendor further warrants that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications.
input.rationale: Meets or exceeds our position: professional and workmanlike services warranty (19.1); 90-day Deliverable conformity running from delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, and hosted Services conformity for the whole subscription term (19.2); no-malicious-code and compliance-with-law warranties (19.3); and a re-perform/repair/replace remedy with a refund and termination backstop that is expressly non-exclusive (19.4). The Section 19.5 disclaimer expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or data-protection duty.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: All preferred limits are present (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation), maintained through the term plus one year, with certificates on request under 18.2 and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No change required.

input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: no minimum or take-or-pay commitment, fees are payable only for ordered Services, and non-ordering is expressly not a shortfall. Section 12.3 reinforces that we have given no minimum-volume undertaking, and Section 7.1 bars unlisted minimum-use charges. Residual risk is limited to a commitment appearing in a future Order Form, which we will police at that stage.

input.quote: Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Preferred position met in full: six months' transition assistance including migration and cooperation with a replacement supplier (11.1); return of all Customer Data within 30 days in a documented machine-readable format with metadata and no fee-dispute hostage (11.2); and secure deletion only after we confirm successful return, certified by an officer (11.3). Section 10.1 keys the access cut-off to the end of the agreed transition period, so there is no gap.
